title: Negatives and Questions Quiz 5
description: Ask with question words, decide when no helper is needed, and answer with short answers.
topic: Question words, subject questions and short answers
instructions: Negatives and Questions: Question words, subject questions and short answers.
Read each question carefully, then check your answer.
Every question has a trap. Read every word.

questions.question: Which question is correct?
questions.explanation: Question word + does + subject + base verb. Watch out: does carries the -s, so live stays in the base form.

questions.question: You want to know the person who broke the window. Which question is correct?
questions.explanation: Who is the subject, so there is no do / did: Who broke the window? Watch out: Who did break would make it emphatic, not neutral.

questions.question: What {{1}} he {{2}} (do) when you called?
questions.explanation: When you called gives a moment in the past, so use the past continuous: What was he doing? Watch out: was is the helper, so did is not added.

questions.question: Who {{1}} (live) next door?
questions.explanation: Who is the subject, so the question keeps statement order: Who lives next door? Watch out: the verb keeps its -s because there is no does.

questions.question: In 'Who did Anna call?', Anna is the subject.
questions.explanation: Anna does the calling, so she is the subject, and who is the object. Watch out: when who is the object, the helper did is needed.

questions.question: Did you call her? Choose the correct short answer.
questions.explanation: A short answer repeats the first helper of the question: Yes, I did. Watch out: do and have are different helpers, and the main verb is not repeated.

questions.question: Choose the correct negative short answer for each question.
questions.explanation: A short answer repeats the helper of the question. Watch out: with Is it open? the answer is it isn't, and with Will you come? it is I won't.

questions.question: Match each question word with what it asks about.
questions.explanation: Each question word asks for a different kind of information. Watch out: whose asks about an owner, and who asks about a person.

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order to make a question.
questions.explanation: Question word, helper, subject, then the main verb. Watch out: the time phrase at nine stays at the end.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Do you know where does she live?
Do you know where she lives?
Do you know where she does live?
Do you know where lives she?
questions.explanation: An indirect question keeps statement order, with no does: where she lives. Watch out: the helper moves back after the subject, not in front of it.

questions.question: Which questions are correct?
options: How long have you been here?
Which bus goes to the station?
questions.explanation: The correct questions use no extra helper for a subject question and the base form after did / does. Watch out: what does he wants and did she went both repeat the tense.

questions.question: Correct the mistake: What time the film starts?
accepted: What time does the film start?
What time does the film start
questions.explanation: The helper does goes before the subject, and the verb returns to the base form: What time does the film start? Watch out: the question word does not replace the helper.
